<style>
  :root {
    --nokia-body: #3a5a40;
    --nokia-body-2: #2c4331;
    --lcd-bg: #9ead74;
    --lcd-bg-2: #8fa068;
    --lcd-ink: #1b2416;
    --lcd-dim: rgba(27,36,22,0.18);
    --key-bg: #2b2b2b;
    --key-bg-2: #1a1a1a;
    --key-text: #d8d8d0;
    --key-lit: #b9d16b;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html, body {
    margin: 0; min-height: 100dvh;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%, #14241a 0%, #0a120d 70%);
    font-family: 'Courier New', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: #cfe0b8;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    padding: 1.5rem 1rem 2.5rem;
    -webkit-user-select: none; user-select: none;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }
  .phone {
    width: 300px; max-width: 100%;
    background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--nokia-body) 0%, var(--nokia-body-2) 100%);
    border-radius: 34px 34px 46px 46px;
    padding: 20px 18px 26px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), inset 0 2px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.14), inset 0 -6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    position: relative;
  }
  .brandbar {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px;
    color: #d5e6bd; font-weight: bold; letter-spacing: 1px;
    font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .brandbar svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; display:block; border-radius:5px; }
  /* ---- LCD ---- */
  .lcd-frame {
    background: #1c2b1e; border-radius: 12px; padding: 10px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), inset 0 3px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  .lcd {
    position: relative;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--lcd-bg) 0%, var(--lcd-bg-2) 100%);
    border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 12px rgba(27,36,22,0.28);
  }
  .statusbar {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    font-size: 9px; font-weight: bold; color: var(--lcd-ink);
    letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 1px 3px 4px; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .statusbar .sig, .statusbar .bat { display:flex; gap:1px; align-items:flex-end; }
  .statusbar .sig i { width:2px; background: var(--lcd-ink); display:block; }
  .statusbar .sig i:nth-child(1){height:3px}
  .statusbar .sig i:nth-child(2){height:5px}
  .statusbar .sig i:nth-child(3){height:7px}
  .statusbar .sig i:nth-child(4){height:9px}
  canvas#board { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; image-rendering: pixelated; border-radius: 2px; }
  .lcd-overlay {
    position:absolute; inset:6px; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center; text-align:center;
    color: var(--lcd-ink); pointer-events:none;
  }
  .lcd-overlay.hidden { display:none; }
  .lcd-overlay h2 { margin:0 0 4px; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:1px; }
  .lcd-overlay p { margin:2px 0; font-size:10px; line-height:1.35; font-weight:bold; }
  .lcd-overlay .big { font-size:22px; margin:4px 0; }
  .blink { animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }
  /* HUD line under the board bar */
  .hud {
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
    font-size:10px; font-weight:bold; color: var(--lcd-ink);
    padding: 3px 3px 1px; letter-spacing:0.5px;
  }
  .hud .boss { color:#5a2d0a; }
  .hud .boss.on { animation: bosspulse 0.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes bosspulse { 50% { opacity:0.25; } }
  /* ---- Keypad ---- */
  .keypad { margin-top: 18px; }
  .navrow {
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .dpad { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,34px); grid-template-rows:repeat(3,26px); gap:3px; }
  .softkeys { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:6px; }
  .btn {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--key-bg) 0%, var(--key-bg-2) 100%);
    color: var(--key-text); border:none; border-radius:8px;
    font-family:inherit; font-weight:bold; cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    transition: transform .05s, box-shadow .05s, background .08s, color .08s;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-size:13px; padding:0;
  }
  .btn:active, .btn.lit {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--key-lit) 0%, #8fae4c 100%);
    color:#20300c; transform: translateY(2px);
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(185,209,107,0.8), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
  }
  .dpad .nav { width:34px; height:26px; }
  .dpad .center { width:34px; height:26px; font-size:9px; }
  .dpad .spacer { visibility:hidden; }
  .softkeys .soft { width:44px; height:20px; font-size:9px; border-radius:6px 6px 10px 10px; }
  .grid {
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:8px;
  }
  .grid .btn {
    height:34px; flex-direction:column; line-height:1;
  }
  .grid .btn .num { font-size:15px; }
  .grid .btn .sub { font-size:8px; opacity:0.6; letter-spacing:1px; margin-top:2px; }
  .hint {
    text-align:center; font-size:10px; color:#7f976a; margin-top:14px; line-height:1.5;
  }
  .hint b { color:#b9d16b; }
</style>

parts.text: Build me a retro snake game styled like the classic Nokia 3310 phone but with Archestra.AI branding, playable with the arrow keys or WASD on a wrap-around board that speeds up as you eat, where each keypress lights up the matching button on the on-screen phone keypad, with regular apple treats and periodic special boss treats that pulse with a countdown timer, sound effects, and bonus points, and save my.
I'll build this for you. Let me start by loading the Build App skill to follow the proper flow, then scaffold the app.
Now let me scaffold the app. This is a self-contained game (no external data needed), so no MCP tools required.
An app with that name already exists. Let me check whether it's the same thing I should reuse or a different app.

There's a name collision, but the existing "Archestra Snake 3310" (v2) doesn't have all your requested features (no WASD, no wrap-around, no speed-up, no keypad-lights-on-keypress). Rather than clobber that existing app, I'll build yours under a distinct name.

A couple of quick questions so I nail the feel (features/style only):

1. **Visual style** — full Nokia 3310 phone chassis around a monochrome green-pixel LCD (that classic pea-soup green), or a cleaner modern take with Archestra's dark theme? I'm assuming the authentic phone shell with green LCD unless you say otherwise.
2. **High score** — saved privately to just you, or a shared org-wide leaderboard so others can compete?
3. Your message got cut off at "and save my..." — I'm reading that as **save my high score**. Anything else you meant there?

I'll proceed with: authentic Nokia shell + green LCD, private high score, arrow keys/WASD, wrap-around, speed-up, keypad lights, apple + pulsing boss treats, sound. Let me scaffold it under a clean name.
App created (id `b778faf8-...`). No MCP tools needed — it's fully self-contained, using per-viewer storage for the high score. Now I'll build the full game as a complete rewrite.

Passed clean, and the live render is error-free. Done.

**[Archestra Snake 3310 — Nokia Edition](/a/b778faf8-3cf5-439b-bb59-7377132ba208)** is ready to play.

It's a full Nokia 3310 in a green-body chassis with the ARCHESTRA.AI wordmark up top and a pea-soup green LCD showing the classic signal/battery status bar. What you get:

- **Steer** with arrow keys, WASD, or the 2/4/6/8 number keys — and every keypress lights up the matching button on the on-screen keypad (the whole D-pad and number grid are also clickable).
- **Wrap-around board** — run off one edge, come out the other.
- **Speeds up** a notch with every apple you eat, down to a fast floor.
- **Apple treats** worth 1 point; every 4 apples spawns a **boss treat** — a pulsing 2×2 block with a live seconds countdown drawn right on it, worth 5 bonus points if you grab it before the timer runs out.
- **Sound effects** for eating, boss grab/spawn, turning, start, and a descending game-over tune (WebAudio, no assets — audio unlocks on your first keypress).
- **High score** saved privately to your Archestra profile, so it persists across sessions.
- **OK / Enter / 5 / space** starts and pauses.

One note on the earlier confusion: there was already an app named "Archestra Snake 3310" that didn't have your full feature set, so I built yours as a separate "Nokia Edition" rather than overwrite it. And I read your cut-off "save my..." as **save my high score** — which it does. If you meant something else there, tell me and I'll wire it in.

enhancement.description: Classic Nokia 3310 Snake with wrap-around board, speed-up, pulsing timed boss treats, a live-lighting keypad, sound, and a saved high score.
